scenario: QAS 3 — Performance during Omnichannel Order Bursts
interpretation: Both QAS 3 targets passed with large margin. Checkout p95=74ms vs 2000ms target (27x headroom). Order-status p95=87ms vs 1000ms target (11x headroom). The async design (no synchronous warehouse/shipping calls in checkout path) is confirmed to work under 5x load on a single Docker host.
